Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2006
ACT VIII OF 2006
Punjab
Local Government (Amendment) Act 2006
An Act
further to amend the Punjab Local Government
Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Punjab; Extraordinary, 11th July, 2006]
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This
Act may be called the Punjab Local Government (Amendment) Act; 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 42 of
the Punjab Ordinance XIII of 2001.---In the said Ordinance, in
section 42, in subsection (4), the words "through a secret ballot"
shall be omitted.
